op_take_quest: the player takes a posted quest (take_quest Q001), at its giver's seat
op_spread: world rule: a rumor reaches another town
op_new_quest: world rule: a faction posts a quest
op_quest: world rule: a quest changes state
op_strike: world rule: a strike starts / ends
line: Several factions run on their own in town (power, wealth and their relations are in the variable table); rumors spread along the roads and quests are posted by the factions. When the story mentions them, go by the variables and the entries, and never decide for a faction.
quest_closed: someone has taken this quest already, or it is over
go_take: it has to be taken at {giver} ({seat})
raid: {name} crept into the {town} stockyard at night
